verdict.rationale: The official README shows `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...-GGUF`, which load and run GGUF-packaged models directly. The CLI, server and web UI usage, plus quantization tiers such as Q6_K, back the core of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or doc page describing GGUF format support and loading local .gguf files, and independent hands-on reports that name GGUF explicitly.
